amazon.add_address  [POST /amazon/addresses]
Add a new address.
  - name (string, required): Name of the address, for example 'Home' or 'Work'.
  - street_address (string, required): Street address line.
  - city (string, required): Name of the city.
  - state (string, required): Name of the state.
  - country (string, required): Name of the country.
  - zip_code (integer, required): 5-digit zip code of the address.
  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.
  response: {"message": "string", "address_id": 1}

amazon.add_gift_wrapping_to_product  [POST /amazon/cart/{product_id}/gift_wrap]
Add gift wrapping to a product in your cart. If the product is already set to be gift wrapped, its quantity will be updated.
  - product_id (integer, required): ID of the product in your cart to be gift wrapped.
  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.
  - quantity (integer, optional): Quantity of the product to be gift wrapped.
  response: {"message": "string"}

amazon.add_payment_card  [POST /amazon/payment_cards]
Add a new payment card.
  - card_name (string, required): Name of the payment card.
  - owner_name (string, required): Full name of the owner of the payment card.
  - card_number (integer, required): 16-digit card number.
  - expiry_year (integer, required): Expiration year of the payment card.
  - expiry_month (integer, required): Expiration month of the payment card.
  - cvv_number (integer, required): A 3-digit CVV number of the payment card.
  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.
  response: {"message": "string", "payment_card_id": 1}

amazon.add_product_to_cart  [POST /amazon/cart/{product_id}]
Add product by id and quantities to your cart.
  - product_id (integer, required): ID of the product to be added to the cart.
  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.
  - quantity (integer, optional): The quantity of the product to be added to the cart.
  - clear_cart_first (boolean, optional): If true, the cart will be cleared before adding the product to the cart.
  response: {"message": "string"}

amazon.add_product_to_wish_list  [POST /amazon/wish_list/{product_id}]
Add product by id and quantities to your wish list.
  - product_id (integer, required): ID of the product to be added to the wish list.
  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.
  - quantity (integer, optional): The quantity of the product to be added to the wish list.
  - clear_wish_list_first (boolean, optional): If true, the wish list will be cleared before adding the product to the wish list.
  response: {"message": "string"}

  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.

amazon.download_order_receipt  [GET /amazon/order_receipt/{order_id}]
Download the receipt of a past order.
  - order_id (integer, required): ID of the order to download the receipt for.
  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.
  - download_to_file_path (string, optional): The file path to download the receipt file to in file system app. Path can be absolute, starting with '/', or relative to the user's home directory, starting with '~/'. If not passed, it will be saved in your ~/downloads directory.
  - overwrite (boolean, optional): Whether to overwrite the file if it already exists.
  - file_system_access_token (string, optional): Access token obtained from file_system app login.
  response: {"message": "string", "file_path": "string"}

amazon.download_prime_subscription_receipt  [GET /amazon/prime/subscriptions/{prime_subscription_id}/receipt]
Download the receipt for a prime subscription.
  - prime_subscription_id (integer, required): ID of the prime subscription to download the receipt for.
  - access_token (string, required): Access token obtained from amazon app login.
  - download_to_file_path (string, optional): The file path to download the receipt file to in file system app. Path can be absolute, starting with '/', or relative to the user's home directory, starting with '~/'. If not passed, it will be saved in your ~/downloads directory.
  - overwrite (boolean, optional): Whether to overwrite the file if it already exists.
  - file_system_access_token (string, optional): Access token obtained from file_system app login.
  response: {"message": "string", "file_path": "string"}

amazon.search_product_types  [GET /amazon/product_types]

amazon.search_products  [GET /amazon/products]
Search for products with a query and various filtering criteria.
  - query (string, optional): The search query string.
  - product_type (string, optional): The type of product to search for.
  - color (string, optional): The color of product to search for.
  - relative_size (string, optional): The relative size of product to search for.
  - min_price (number, optional): The minimum price for search results.
  - max_price (number, optional): The maximum price for search results.
  - min_product_rating (number, optional): The minimum product rating for search results.
  - max_product_rating (number, optional): The maximum product rating for search results.
  - min_seller_rating (number, optional): The minimum seller rating for search results.
  - max_seller_rating (number, optional): The maximum seller rating for search results.
  - seller_id (integer, optional): ID of the seller to search for.
  - page_index (integer, optional): The index of the page to return.
  - page_limit (integer, optional): The maximum number of results to return per page.
  - sort_by (string, optional): The attribute to sort the products by prefixed with +/- to reflect ascending/descending. Valid attributes: rating, price and delivery_days. If both query and sort_by are given and non-empty, results will be first ranked by query relevance, then paginated, and will then be sorted by the given attribute within each page.
